settings.colour_note: Prefer black parts. A black version of the same model at the same or lower landed cost replaces the pick; black options that cost more or change the spec are suggested with reason 'colour'.

fit_limits.notes: GPU length is 435mm without front fans; the two 25mm front fans make it about 410mm. 95mm = card thickness + bottom fan: Jonsbo quotes 117mm from the top slot, but the Mortar's x16 slot may sit one slot lower, so 95mm is used to be safe. PSU 160mm = the ATX front bay (an ATX PSU leaves room for 2×120mm front fans). The top takes a 240 or 360mm radiator. With an AIO there's no air-cooler limit on RAM; kits up to 43mm clear the radiator. Case fans: 3 bottom, 2 front, 1 rear; the top three mounts hold the radiator fans. Air-cooler limit if ever swapped: 172mm.

log.text: Tracker created from the 16 Oct sheet: 9 parts, £2,158.79.
Scan 9800X3D re-checked: £379.98 (was £384.98). Watercooling UK case confirmed £83.99 inc VAT.
New swap idea s2: Gigabyte RX 9070 XT Gaming OC at Amazon UK £757.99, about £21 under the current GPU's landed cost.
Could not re-check Overclockers UK prices for CPU, RAM, GPU and fans today (site blocks checks); entries go stale after 19 Oct.
Very vetted: delivers to NI, free on £75+. AWD-IT and Box still unverified (no NI terms published).
Colour preference set to black: case → Jonsbo Z20 (black), cooler → Peerless Assassin 120 SE Black. Black RAM and motherboard options added as swap ideas.
Re-checked: Watercooling UK case £83.99 in stock; Currys black CL28 RAM £489; Gigabyte RX 9070 XT Gaming OC still £757.99 at Amazon UK (£749.99 at Overclockers UK).
Added Currys as a backup shop for the white KLEVV CL28 RAM (£489). Overclockers UK still blocks checks, so its RAM, GPU and fan prices from 16 Oct go stale after today.
No new swap ideas: no cheaper RX 9070 XT, RAM or 2TB SSD option met the rules at a vetted shop.
Fans: Scan has the Arctic P12 Pro PST LN 5-pack at £24.98 (low stock), added as an offer; about £18 under Overclockers UK landed. Fan swap idea s1 expired (no longer saves £10).
Re-checked: Scan 9800X3D £379.98; Currys KLEVV FIT V CL28 £489 (white and black). EE Tech & Gaming marked as no NI delivery (mainland only).
Overclockers UK still blocks checks: CPU, RAM, GPU and fan prices from 16 Oct are stale. No new swap ideas: cheaper RX 9070 XT, RAM and SSD listings were only at marketplace shops.
GPU: Overclockers UK lists the ASUS RX 9070 XT Prime OC at £698.99 in stock (was £758.99), now the cheapest landed at about £718.98. Gigabyte Gaming OC swap idea s2 expired (no longer cheaper).
Fans: Scan's Arctic P12 Pro PST LN 5-pack is now pre-order (due 11 Nov), so Overclockers UK is the only in-stock source. CPU: Overclockers UK page shows £359.99 but stock couldn't be confirmed.
Re-checked: Watercooling UK Z20 black £83.99 in stock. No new swap ideas: cheaper RX 9070 XT and DDR5-6000 kits were only at marketplace or unvetted sellers.
CPU: Scan's 9800X3D is now £399.98 (was £379.98), so the CPU is about £20 dearer. Overclockers UK's £359.99 still can't be confirmed in stock.
RAM: added AWD-IT as a restock watch for the white KLEVV CL28 kit (£394.99, out of stock). Re-checked Watercooling UK case £83.99, Scan fans £24.98 (pre-order, due 11 Nov) and Currys RAM £489.
No new swap ideas: the cheaper RX 9070 XT listings (PowerColor Reaper, XFX Quicksilver/Mercury) were only at marketplace or unvetted sellers.

Build switched to the all-black Jonsbo D33 plan from 22 Oct: 13 lines incl. Windows, £2,191.52 in parts (£2,211.51 with Overclockers UK delivery). Z20-era swap ideas cleared; price history restarted for the new parts.

Optimised: PSU £89.99 at Amazon, black CL28 RAM (+96p), Thermalright cooler/fans/screen from Computer Orbit instead of marketplace sellers, £0.85 Kolink splitter in the Overclockers UK order. Parts £2,174.65.
Overclockers UK's PriceSpy feed ignored (it lags the site); its own product pages and sweep checks count. Computer Orbit and Microsoft Store vetted.
